algorithm.title: Initial Management Algorithm for Pulmonary Artery Hypertension

cell.label: Oral anticoagulant, especially if idiopathic PAH (IPAH), diuretics oxygen. Perform acute vasoreactivity testing during catheterization.
Oral CCB, especially if IPAH. Sustained response?
Sildenafil, treprostinil SC, or treprostinil IV.
Bosentan, sildenafil, eporostenol, iloprost, treprostinil SC, or treprostinil IV.
Epoprostenol IV, bosentan, Iloprost, sildenafil, treprostinil SC, or treprostinil IV.
Patient fails to improve or deteriorates.
Consider: 1. Combination of bosentan, sildenafil, and prostanoid. 2. Referral for atrioseptostomy or lung transplant.
